summary: DailyTxT is a self-hosted web application designed for recording daily personal notes and memories with encryption. It provides a text interface alongside search capabilities and support for encrypted file uploads.
goodFor: It suits individuals wanting a private, self-hosted journal or scratchpad running locally or on a personal private server.
watchOut: The project lacks tagged releases and shows slowing maintenance activity, which may introduce risks for long-term data storage.
deployNotes: As a containerised web application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for your journal data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
